Strategy: Aim one third up from the tightest bin. Prefer the bin closest to one third of the way from the smallest to the largest residual: tight enough to fill well, while the tightest stay saved for exact fits and the loosest for big items. Ranking can differ from Best Fit whenever that lower-third bin is not the tightest. It may help by balancing fill against preservation, but may fail by passing up tight fits for a merely average bin.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    t = min(bins) + (max(bins) - min(bins)) / 3
    return [-abs(r - t) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Lower-third targeting: prefer bin closest to min + (max-min)/3.
